summary:
Built "ROXY", a 31x56x37 Art Deco cinema, front facing north, as code (`build.mjs`, `roof.json`). The cream body has a black plinth and frieze, quartz fins and teal panels, with gold, black and teal accents.
The roof is the `modern` preset, picked for a commercial block. The dry-run came back clean once I gave it a mixed deck palette through `--spec`.
A three-tier stepped tower with stepped pylons carries a raised gold "ROXY" plaque and a gold finial. A gold sunburst, a marquee, a ticket booth and recessed poster alcoves sit below it.
`mcd check` shows nothing floating. 16 "unsupported" lines are sea lanterns misread as hanging blocks (the checker's false positives), plus 2 orphan letter strokes. Palette flags are down to two intentional ones.
Deliverables are in the working directory: `build.nbt`, `elements.md`, `tasks.json` (10 tasks), `gaps.md`.
elements: Stepped central tower, the Deco skyline: `setbacks` brush with three flush-front tiers and quartz cornices, plus stepped `fins` pylons at each tier
Cinema name in lights: `plaque()` block letters, raised gold "ROXY" on a black terracotta board (15 wide, narrow font)
Entrance marquee: black block canopy with a sea-lantern soffit, a gold/quartz edge and `plaque()` banner letters reading NOW SHOWING, plus 3 hanging lanterns
Sunburst over the entrance: gold hub and 7 rays, built in code, standing 1 block proud of a teal wall
Ticket booth: glass-pane kiosk with a black base, gold top and a `B.sign` reading TICKETS
Entrance: recessed 2-deep vestibule, four real `B.door` dark oak leaves in two pairs, cyan glass fanlights, gold door columns
Poster cases: 4 recessed alcoves per front wing, each with `B.banner` posters (patterned banners) and hanging lanterns
Vertical fins and chevron frieze: stepped quartz fins on the front, sides and back, and a zigzag of quartz stairs on a black band
Stained-glass slits: cyan glass panes alternating with quartz stripes on tower tiers 2 and 3, plus slit windows in the wings
Roof: `mcd roof` `modern` preset (flat deck, parapet, coping, dentil-free cornice, rail), black cornice trim

Sides and back: recessed teal panels between fins, iron exit doors with glowing red `B.sign` EXIT signs, `CINEMA` hanging blade signs on the front piers, street lamps (nether-brick fence plus lantern)
polish: The sunburst is only 11 cells wide, so it reads as a gold crown from a 3/4 view and as a fan only head-on. It wants a larger or smoother build.
The cream (smooth sandstone) looks olive on the shaded sides; calcite and white terracotta were worse. A warmer, brighter cream is still needed.
The front tower reads strongly, but the sides and back are the same fin-and-panel rhythm with no windows, lights or ground-level props beyond the exit doors.
The CINEMA blade signs render as chunky birch boxes; the vertical neon-style sign the building wants is not there.
The roof deck is a large dark blank plane, and the black cornice makes the top read a little heavy next to the white coping that was dropped.
The vestibule is dark at street level: the doors and glass fanlights are small and not lit, and there is no interior.
The tower has no sea-lantern lights on its pylons. The marquee is lit but the tower is not.
Two raised letter strokes of ROXY are flagged as orphans by `mcd check`. The sea-lantern "unsupported" lines are false positives.
No size was given in the brief, so I chose 27x28 plus a tower; the tower is very tall against the body (about 3:1 to the eave).
No weathering, planters or street furniture beyond two lamps; the 10 tasks in `tasks.json` cover most of this.
